feature.summary: Cloud code runs in an isolated remote sandbox, but only when the server cutover flag AGI_E2B_EXECUTION is 1, a sandbox key and a compute price are set, and the plan includes AGI Code (Basic or above). A cloud browser and a cloud virtual computer do not exist; the cloud browser is declared unavailable.

purpose.what_it_does: Provides managed isolated sandboxes where the model runs code and where coding sessions run, billed by compute seconds. It also records that a cloud browser and a cloud computer are not built.
purpose.why_it_exists: Running untrusted code needs isolation, metering and limits. Users without a local setup still want code execution in the cloud.
purpose.who_uses_it: Paid users of AGI Code on the web and users whose chat uses the code-execution tool; operators who enable the sandbox.
problems_solved: Running generated code safely away from the user's machine.
Charging for sandbox seconds and refusing when no price exists.
Keeping credentials out of the sandbox (egress proxy rules).
use_cases: A Basic user opens a Code session on the web and runs a repo task.
A chat turn runs a Python snippet in the sandbox when the execution tool is on.
On a deployment where the flag is off, the code session is refused with 'Managed Code is not enabled for this deployment. Use the desktop app for local code.'
A user asking the agent to drive a cloud browser gets the built-in browser or the user's own Chrome instead.

where_to_find_it: Web: the Code workspace at /code and /code/[sessionId] (apps/web/app/code/[sessionId]/page.tsx); '/code/computer' titled 'Your computer · Code' sends tasks to the user's own computer, not a cloud computer (apps/web/app/code/computer/page.tsx).
Desktop: coding sessions run locally (see F102-05, F102-06).
Visible entry label on the web nav: unknown.
prerequisites: A plan that includes AGI Code: sandbox count above 0 and a coding-agent daily budget above 0 (billing-catalog.ts:836-839 planIncludesAgiCode); Free has 2 sandboxes but budget 0, so it does not include Code. basic and above do (budget 100 cents/day for basic).
Server: AGI_E2B_EXECUTION=1, E2B_API_KEY set and a priced compute rate (apps/web/lib/e2b/gate.ts:20-28).
Managed compute private beta not switched off (AGI_MANAGED_COMPUTE_PRIVATE_BETA; default on, apps/web/lib/managed-compute-gate.ts:55-58).
screens_and_controls: Code session creation (POST /api/code/sessions), network access choice (Isolated, Trusted hosts, Full internet) and extra hosts; full internet refused while credentials would enter the sandbox (cloud-code-session-open.ts:62-100).
journey: 1. The user starts a Code session.
2. The server checks the deployment gates, workspace policy, managed-compute access and plan.
3. The server provisions a sandbox after reserving compute funds.
4. The user or agent runs code; output returns.
5. Idle sandboxes are reclaimed by a cron (vercel.json:54).
feedback_and_outputs: Errors: 'Managed Code is not enabled for this deployment. Use the desktop app for local code.'; 'Managed compute is temporarily unavailable. Use Local or BYOK in the meantime, or try again shortly.'; 'Your plan does not include managed Code sessions' (cloud-code-session-service.ts:1245).
Code-run route says 'Running code is not available on this deployment.' (chat code-runs route.ts:76).
settings: Network access, runtime id and extra hosts per session.
Server env names: AGI_E2B_EXECUTION, E2B_API_KEY, AGI_E2B_COMPUTE_MICROUSD_PER_SECOND, AGI_MANAGED_COMPUTE_PRIVATE_BETA (apps/web/.env.example:384-386, :435).

working: Gates: cutover flag is exactly '1'; provisioning is ready only with flag, key and a resolvable compute price (gate.ts:16-28). The weaker e2bExecutionEnabled is key OR flag (gate.ts:9-14).

Session open refuses when provisioning is not ready or beta is off, then checks egress rules, harness credentials, workspace gates, managed compute access and plan (cloud-code-session-open.ts:37-200).
Runtime fails closed: refuses to provision without a compute rate or funds reservation (apps/web/lib/e2b/runtime.ts:801, :886, :941).

Chat tool loop returns 'Tool ... is not available.' for execution tools when the cutover is off (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/tool-loop.ts:2802-2808); code-runs route answers service unavailable (apps/web/app/api/chat/conversations/[id]/code-runs/route.ts:76).
Idle sandbox reclaim cron and stuck code-turn reaper (vercel.json:54, :58).
Cloud code turns run as a durable workflow (apps/web/lib/workflows/cloud-code-turn-workflow.ts:143).
incomplete: The brief says that with the sandbox off, code runs on the provider-native interpreter; the code only shows the execution tools becoming unavailable when the cutover is off. Provider-native fallback was not found: unknown.
disconnected_or_disabled: Sandbox is off by default: the example environment ships AGI_E2B_EXECUTION=0 (apps/web/.env.example:384).

Cloud browser is declared but disabled: BROWSER_SESSION_CAPABILITIES.cloud has available:false and the reason 'The cloud browser is not available yet. Run this in the built-in browser, or in your own Chrome through the AGI extension.' (packages/contracts/types/src/browser-session.ts:34-59).
not_available: Cloud browser runtime (S102.09) and cloud virtual-computer runtime (S102.10): missing in the ledger (audit/ledger/ecosystem-capability-ledger.jsonl:3171-3172; audit/missing/102-runtime-inventory.md).

The Chrome extension's cloud agent client sends a task to a cloud agent but drives the user's own browser; it is not a cloud browser (apps/extension/src/features/computer-use/cloudAgentClient.ts:1-15).

established.statement: Cloud code runs in an isolated remote sandbox. Status: partial (off unless AGI_E2B_EXECUTION=1; turn it on in production).
The product runs a browser in the cloud that the agent can drive. Status: missing.
The product runs a virtual computer in the cloud that the agent can operate. Status: missing.
Sandbox compute must be priced; provisioning fails closed otherwise.

acceptance_criteria: With AGI_E2B_EXECUTION unset or 0, opening a Code session returns the 'not enabled for this deployment' error.
With flag 1 and key but no compute rate, provisioning is not ready and no sandbox is created.
A Free-plan user is refused with 'Your plan does not include managed Code sessions'.
With everything on, a Basic user can open a session and the cap on active sessions equals the plan's sandbox count.
With the flag off, a chat turn that calls an execution tool receives 'is not available'.
The cloud browser capability reports available false with the stated reason.
inferred: Local and own-key users keep code execution on their own computer (error text points to the desktop app) [inferred].
proposed: [proposed] Turn the sandbox on in production once pricing is configured, as the brief says.
[proposed] Decide whether the cloud browser and cloud computer are on the roadmap; the contract already reserves a 'cloud' browser session kind.

steps.what_happens: The web client asks to open a session.
The server checks deployment gates, workspace policy, plan and spend.
The server reserves compute funds and creates the remote sandbox through the sandbox vendor.
Code runs in the sandbox; provider credentials stay behind an egress proxy.
Results return to the server and client; sandbox seconds are settled.

execution_and_data_flow.models_and_providers: Sandboxes come from one outside sandbox vendor (named in code only as E2B). Model calls from a coding agent inside the sandbox go through a provider proxy keyed per session (lib/e2b/provider-proxy*.ts); which harnesses have managed credentials is checked at open (cloud-code-session-open.ts:84-100).

access_and_usage.permissions: Workspace code policy and feature gate (cloud-code-session-open.ts:107-130).
access_and_usage.subscription: planIncludesAgiCode: plan:basic and above; Free refused (billing-catalog.ts:836-839; cloud-code-session-service.ts:1244). Subscription access check allows Free and missing subscriptions at that layer and blocks inactive paid ones (managed-compute-access.ts:69-100).
access_and_usage.limits_and_metering: Active sandboxes per plan (free 2, basic 5, pro 10, max and max_15x the managed cap), daily coding-agent budget per plan (basic 100, pro 500, max 2500, max_15x 7500 cents); compute seconds priced and reserved.
access_and_usage.model_compatibility: unknown for the in-sandbox coding agent beyond the harness list.
access_and_usage.provider_restrictions: Harness credentials must be available or the user brings a key (cloud-code-session-open.ts:84-100).
access_and_usage.local_mode: Not available: the error tells local users to use the desktop app for local code.

states_and_edge_cases.behaviour: Capability-unavailable error; chat execution tools report not available.
A resumed sandbox interval is limited to what its hold still funds (runtime.ts:~895-935).

scenarios.name: Flag off
steps: Try to open a Code session.
scenarios.expected: Error 'Managed Code is not enabled for this deployment...'.

scenarios.name: No price
steps: Set flag 1 and a key but no compute rate.
scenarios.expected: Not ready; refused; no sandbox created.

scenarios.name: Plan
steps: Enable everything on a test deployment.
Open a session as Free, then as Basic.
scenarios.expected: Free refused with plan message; Basic opens.

scenarios.name: Execution tool off
steps: With flag 0, ask chat to run code with the execution tool declared.
scenarios.expected: Tool result 'is not available' and the model explains.

scenarios.name: Cloud browser
steps: Read the browser session capability for kind cloud.
scenarios.expected: available false with the unavailable reason.

The cloudAgentClient.ts head (lines 1-20) imports the managed chat routing/free-trial client and shows no statement that it drives a local browser; the 'not a cloud browser' reading rests on lines 1-15 which only show imports, so the citation does not support it.

missing_facts: Free plan has maxSandboxes 2 but is refused Code; yet the chat code tool also uses a sandbox, and the page does not say which plans may use the chat execution tool (gate is only e2bCutoverEnabled in tool-loop.ts:2802 and code-runs/route.ts:76, with no planIncludesAgiCode check there) - billing-catalog.ts:834-839 comment says 'the chat code tool uses one too'.
The managed sandbox cap value is 20 (MAX_MANAGED_SANDBOXES_PER_USER) and per-plan sandbox TTL (sandboxTtlMs, e.g. Free 60 minutes) is a limit the page omits: billing-catalog.ts:473, 626.
Workspace policy gates run per extra egress host (reach_host) in addition to open_cloud_session: cloud-code-session-open.ts:124-135.
